english.title: Erect or install unsafe work article / fairground equipment

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Health and Safety at Work Act 1974

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who

(A)_[erected an article, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..), for use at work in premises at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), where that article was to be used by persons at work,]_
(B)_[installed an article, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..), for use at work in premises at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), where that article was to be used by persons at work,]_
(C)_[erected an article of fairground equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..),]_
(D)_[installed an article of fairground equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..),]_

failed to discharge your duty to ensure, so far as was reasonably practicable, that nothing about the way in which the article was

(E)_[erected]_
(F)_[installed]_

made it unsafe or a risk to health at a time when it was being

(G)_[set, used, cleaned or maintained by a person at work]_
(H)_[used for or in connection with the entertainment of members of the public]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 6(3) and 33(1)(a) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person erected / installed article for use at work
in premises where it was to be used by persons at work/fairground equipment
fail to ensure installation / erection had not made it unsafe
when set / used / cleaned / maintained by person at work OR
used for / in connection with the entertainment of members of the public

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 2(2) of the Act for examples of the extent of the employer's duty.
(ii) Proceedings for an offence shall not, in England and Wales, be instituted except by an inspector of the Environment Agency or the Natural Resources Body for Wales or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions, see section 38 of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.

other.penalty:
Either way -
Summary: 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2002; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see Schedule 3A to the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
